cues.text: Thorndyke’s
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Good morning. Is that Mr Thorndyke?
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Speaking. How can I help?
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: I’ve got quite a few things which need painting and fixing in the flat and I wonder whether you’d be able to do the work.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: I’m sure I’d be able to help but let me take down a few details.
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Yes, of course.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Well, firstly, how did you hear about us?
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: It was my friend May Hampton … you did some excellent work for her a couple of years ago. Do you remember?
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Oh, yes, that was in West Park Flats, lovely lady.
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Yes, she is.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: And what’s your name, please?
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: It’s Edith Pargetter.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Edith … can you spell your surname, please?
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: It’s P-A-R-G-E-double T-E-R.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Double T, right. And do you live in West Park Flats as well?
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: No, actually it’s East Park, Flat 4.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Oh, right, that’s over the road, I seem to remember – quite difficult to get to.
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Yes, it’s at the back of the library.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Right, I know. And what’s your phone number?
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: 875934 but I’m out a great deal in the afternoons and evenings.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: So would the best time to ring you be in the morning?
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Yes.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Fine. I’ve made a note of that. Can I just ask, I’ll be in a van and I know parking’s rather difficult round your flats. Where would you recommend?
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Well, I always tell people in larger vehicles to park by the postbox on the other side of the road from the entrance.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Good, thanks.
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: And will you be able to give me a full itemised quote?
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Oh, yes, I’ll list all the jobs separately with individual prices.
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: That’d be a great help.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: No problem.
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Now, what would you like me to do?
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Firstly and most urgently is in the kitchen. With all the weather damage, the glass in the door has cracked and I’d need that fixing …
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: I presume you mean replacing?
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Oh, yes. And as soon as possible …
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: What I’ll do is come round tomorrow morning and do that immediately.
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Thank you so much. The other things aren’t so urgent but …
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Now, I’ll make a note of everything you want doing.
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Well, in the kitchen I’d like some painting doing.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: All the kitchen walls?
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Just the area over the cooker. It’s very greasy …
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Right … it does tend to get that way!
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Yes!
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Well, if you want a proper job done what I’d need to do is strip the old paint and plaster it about a week before I paint it.
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Of course. Now, May tells me you also do work in the garden.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: That’s right.
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Well, I’d like you to replace a fence.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Just one?
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: Yes, at the far end.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Fine. Shouldn’t be a problem.
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: And that’s the lot.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: Fine. Yeah, as I say I can come round tomorrow morning to look over things with you.
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE

cues.text: That’s great, thank you.
cues.speaker: EDITH

cues.text: So, I’ll look forward to seeing you tomorrow at …
cues.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
